provider_boundary: Host and renderer adapters implement grants and return semantic results or opaque resource IDs; portable components never receive browser, JavaScript, operating-system, or toolkit objects.

capabilities.name: accessibility
capabilities.purpose: Expose semantic roles, names, states, relationships, announcements, and backend accessibility mapping.
capabilities.security: Reject untrusted markup or backend objects; announcements contain bounded public text.
capabilities.unsupported_behavior: Use the family accessibility alternative or declare the renderer unsupported.

capabilities.name: clipboard
capabilities.purpose: Request bounded copy or paste operations through host policy and user gesture requirements.
capabilities.security: Permission, origin, gesture, size, and content policy are host-owned.
capabilities.unsupported_behavior: Keep ordinary text entry and selection; omit clipboard enhancements.

capabilities.name: files
capabilities.purpose: Request user-mediated file selection and opaque file resources with bounded metadata and reads.
capabilities.security: No filesystem path crosses the contract; grants are user-mediated, bounded, revocable, and scoped.
capabilities.unsupported_behavior: Provide an ordinary host upload/action alternative or an explicit unavailable state.

capabilities.name: focus
capabilities.purpose: Move, restore, contain, and inspect semantic focus through renderer-owned identities.
capabilities.security: Targets are component-owned semantic IDs, never CSS selectors or backend nodes.
capabilities.unsupported_behavior: Use document order and inline interaction or reject support for focus-critical families.

capabilities.name: keyboard
capabilities.purpose: Receive normalized semantic key intents and shortcuts within an owned scope.
capabilities.security: No raw global keylogger or unrestricted event object; scope, repeat, composition, and cleanup are explicit.
capabilities.unsupported_behavior: Expose equivalent ordinary actions and pointer-independent navigation where possible.

capabilities.name: measurement
capabilities.purpose: Observe bounded semantic geometry, viewport class, and placement constraints.
capabilities.security: Results are normalized measurements for owned identities, not backend node handles.
capabilities.unsupported_behavior: Use inline, fixed-layout, or nonvirtualized alternatives.

capabilities.name: network
capabilities.purpose: Attach optional remote providers or commands through an authenticated server-adapter contract.
capabilities.security: Presentation is never authorization; servers authenticate, validate, reload trusted state, authorize, bound, and audit commands.
capabilities.unsupported_behavior: Use local/static data, cached bounded state, retry policy, or explicit unavailable behavior.

capabilities.name: notifications
capabilities.purpose: Request host notification delivery beyond the in-application feedback surface.
capabilities.security: Permission, visibility, rate, content, and origin policy remain host-owned.
capabilities.unsupported_behavior: Retain the accessible in-application notification surface.

capabilities.name: pointer
capabilities.purpose: Receive normalized activation, drag, resize, and gesture intents with capture ownership.
capabilities.security: No raw backend event or pointer object crosses the contract; capture is scoped and disposable.
capabilities.unsupported_behavior: Provide keyboard, form, or direct-action alternatives.

capabilities.name: storage
capabilities.purpose: Persist bounded nonsecret preferences or drafts under explicit namespace, quota, and expiry policy.
capabilities.security: No secrets or authoritative state; values are versioned, bounded, untrusted, and clearable.
capabilities.unsupported_behavior: Use in-memory state and document loss across restart.

capabilities.name: surface
capabilities.purpose: Create, place, stack, dismiss, and dispose transient semantic surfaces.
capabilities.security: Surface content remains component-owned semantic UI; no portal or window object is exposed.
capabilities.unsupported_behavior: Render inline disclosure, navigate to a dedicated view, or declare unavailable.

capabilities.name: system-theme
capabilities.purpose: Observe normalized system color-scheme, contrast, and motion preferences.
capabilities.security: Expose only bounded preference categories and dispose observation with the owner.
capabilities.unsupported_behavior: Use the application-selected BlazeX theme and accessible defaults.

capabilities.name: time
capabilities.purpose: Schedule bounded delays, animation intents, and periodic work under host lifecycle policy.
capabilities.security: Timers are owner-scoped, cancellable, rate-limited, and invalid after generation disposal.
capabilities.unsupported_behavior: Disable automatic progression/animation and preserve manual interaction.

capabilities.name: window
capabilities.purpose: Observe and request normalized navigation, visibility, viewport, scroll, and close lifecycle operations.
capabilities.security: No global object or unrestricted navigation; origin, user intent, scope, and cleanup are host-owned.
capabilities.unsupported_behavior: Use ordinary navigation/actions and omit lifecycle enhancements.
